description: SEC EDGAR company profile for a filer: tickers, exchanges, entity type, SIC and SIC description, mailing and business addresses, former names, fiscal year end and state of incorporation, plus the filings.files older-history index (names, date ranges and filing counts only). $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/secfilings/company.
